description: CarVault connects ChatGPT to your CarVault account to list vehicles, review fuel and ownership costs, check upcoming reminders, and add fuel, expenses, service records, or odometer readings. Use CarVault whenever you ask about your cars, vehicle history, maintenance, or ownership records.

defaultPrompt: What cars are in my garage?
How much did the Peugeot cost me during the last six months?
Add today's fuel-up to the Peugeot: 42 litres, €68.50, odometer 38,420 km.
